entries.source:
Add up to 20 images with Android's file picker. The bottom tray shows thumbnails, filenames, image dimensions after cropping and any Same width or Same height adjustment, and file modification times when supplied by the provider. Sort by filename or modification time; sorting does not rearrange placed images.

Tap a thumbnail to select it. Crop image trims that image; Batch crop applies pixel or percentage margins to selected images. Drag crop handles or type amounts. Reset crop restores the original edges. Cropping is non-destructive and can be undone.

Hold a thumbnail, or drag an image already in the workspace, then drop it onto a highlighted edge. The translucent preview shows the exact snapped result. A right attachment aligns the tops; a bottom attachment aligns the left edges. You can also tap a thumbnail and then a + target. When snapping, the first image starts at the origin. Attached images may move when their parent is cropped. Overlaps are rejected when snapping.

Select an image and use Exact position to set its top-left X/Y coordinates in whole pixels, starting at zero. Other images keep their positions, and overlaps are allowed.

Same width and Same height give every input a common dimension while preserving each image's own aspect ratio. Choose pixels, percent, Smallest or Largest. Restore original sizes removes normalization and keeps crops.

Unplace returns only the selected image to the tray. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. Remove deletes only that input. Undo/Redo restore these changes. Drag a placed image to rearrange it; empty-space dragging pans. Pinch to zoom. «Show all» adjusts the zoom to show the whole assembly; it never changes output dimensions.

Save PNG saves the assembled image directly. Edit in Paint transfers it into the main editor as an undoable replacement. If the output exceeds the memory budget, choose a smaller output copy if offered. If even a tiny output exceeds the budget, the app shows a memory warning instead of a size chooser. Original source files stay unchanged. The current assembly is stored locally and reopens when you return.

This mode uses the same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits shown in the main editor's «File > About, licences & credits» panel.
entries.wording:
Usa i ramientan Android para un atyik asta 20 na pinenta. Gi bandeha gi papa', mamostra i dikiki' na mostran kada pinenta, i na'an i dokumentu, yan i mineddung dispues di ma'atyik i påtti ni para u ma'usa yan dispues di maseha håfa na tinilaika ni mafa'tinas ni «Parehu na finedda'» pat «Parehu na attura». Mamostra lokkue' i fechan tinilaika yanggin ha na'i i sisteman dokumentu. Siña un na'arekla i bandeha sigun gi na'an pat i fechan tinilaika; ti mamomuyi i pinenta siha ni mapega esta.

Patcha un dikiki' na mostra para un atyik i pinenta. «Atyik i påtti gi pinenta para u ma'usa» para un tutot i oriyan ayu na pinenta. «Atyik i påtti para u ma'usa gi meggai na pinenta» para un tutot i oriyan i pinenta siha ni ma'atyik, gi pixels pat put sientu. Håla i go'tihan siha pat tugi' i numiru siha. «Atyik ta'lu enteru i pinenta» para u fanma'usa ta'lu i urihinåt na oriya. Ti matulaika i urihinåt na dokumentu, ya siña un na'ta'lu i estådo åntis.

Go'ti un dikiki' na mostra pat håla un pinenta ni mapega esta, pues libera gi oriyan ni ma na'annuk. I mostra ni siña un li'e' i san papa'-ña ha na'annuk eksåktu i lugåt ni para u mapega. Yanggin mapega gi akat, parehu i sanhilo' i dos na pinenta; yanggin mapega gi papa', parehu i akagui'. Siña lokkue' un patcha i dikiki' na mostra, pues patcha un siñåt +. Gi esti na manera, i primet na pinenta tutuhun gi X=0, Y=0. Yanggin matutot i oriyan un pinenta, siña mamuyi i pinenta siha ni mapega gi oriya-ña. Ti masisedi na u matampe un pinenta ni ottru yanggin mapega gi oriya.

Atyik un pinenta ya usa «Eksåktu na lugåt» para un tugi' i X yan Y para i eskina sanhilo' gi akagui'. Intiru na pixels i X yan Y, disdi seru. Ti mamomuyi i ottru na pinenta siha. Siña matampe un pinenta ni ottru gi esti na manera.

«Parehu na finedda'» yan «Parehu na attura» ha na'parehu i mineddung ni ma'atyik para todu i pinenta siha, lao ha adahi i guinaha na proporsion kada pinenta. Atyik pixels, put sientu, «I mås dikiki'» pat «I mås dångkulu». «Na'ta'lu i urihinåt na mineddung siha» ha na'ta'lu i mineddung siha sin tulaika i inatyik i påtti siha ni para u ma'usa.

«Na'suha ginin i lugåt» ha na'ta'lu i pinenta ni ma'atyik ha' gi bandeha. I ottru na pinenta siha mapega trabiha; siña mamuyi i pinenta siha ni mapega gi oriyan ayu na pinenta para u matåmpi i bakånti. «Na'suha» ha lakngus ayu ha' na pinenta ginin i dinanña'. Siña un na'lo gi estådo åntis pat usa «Rinueba». Håla un pinenta ni mapega para un tulaika i lugåt-ña. Håla gi lugåt ni tåya' pinenta para un muebi i mostra. Na'hihot pat na'chågu' i dos na kålulot para un tulaika i zoom. «Na'annuk todu» ha tulaika i zoom para u mamostra todu i dinanña'; ti ha tulaika i mineddung i pinenta ni para u mahuyong.

«Po'lu PNG» ha po'lu i pinenta ni ginin i dinanña' direktu. «Tulaika gi Paint» ha na'hålum i dinanña' gi editor prinsipat kumu inalikun i brin; siña un na'lo gi estådo åntis. Yanggin ti nahung i RAM para i pinenta ni para u mahuyong, atyik un mås dikiki' na kopia yanggin mana'i hao este na inatyik. Yanggin ti nahung i RAM maskeseha dikiki' i pinenta, para u mamostra un atbisu put i RAM, ti un inatyik put i mineddung. Ti matulaika i urihinåt na dokumentu siha. Mapo'lu i dinanña' gi tråstis ya mababa ta'lu an bumira hao.

Esti na manera ha usa i mesmu na kreditu para Catrobat/AGPL yan i pinenta yan ikonu siha ni mamostra gi editor prinsipat: «Dokumentu > Put AN Paint, lisensia siha, yan håyi fuma'tinas».

entries.source: Catrobat's own artwork uses CC BY-SA 4.0. Keep the creator credit and share adaptations under that licence. Check the source page for any separate attribution. The source URL will be kept under File > About, licences & credits > Image credits.
entries.wording: I pinenta siha ni Catrobat mismo fuma'tinas ha usa i lisensia CC BY-SA 4.0. Adahi i kreditu para i fuma'tinas, ya kumpåtti i adaptasion siha gi papa' ayu na lisensia. Eksamina i påhinan i orihin para otro na kreditu ni nisisåriu. I URL ginin i orihin mapo'lu gi «Dokumentu > Put AN Paint, lisensia siha, yan håyi fuma'tinas > Kreditu para i pinenta siha».

entries.source: Tap an enclosed area. Adjust tolerance for similar colours.
entries.wording: Patcha un lugåt ni ma'ensigidas ni kåntu siha. Tulaika «Diferensian kulot ni ma sedi» para u fanma'inkluye i kulot siha ni guaha diki' na diferensia.

entries.source: Tap vertices, then double-tap the last vertex to close the polygon. Finish polygon also works. Switch off Close polygon to draw connected open line segments.
entries.wording: Patcha kada punta, pues patcha dos biahi i uttimu para u masera i hechura. Siña lokkue' un usa «Na'funhåyan i hechura ginin tunas na råya siha ni mandanña'». Desaktiba «Na'danña' i uttimu na punta yan i primet na punta» para un dibuhu i tunas na råya siha ni mandanña' lao ti masera i hechura.
Notisia siha ginin otro na pumublika

entries.source: This BMP or GIF uses a colour profile that AN Paint cannot convert yet. Convert it to sRGB PNG in a colour-managed editor before importing.
entries.wording: Esti na BMP pat GIF ha usa un klåsin infutmasion put i kulot ni AN Paint trabiha ti siña ha tulaika. Tulaika para sRGB PNG gi un editor ni ha usa i infutmasion put i kulot, åntis di un na'hålum i pinenta.

entries.source: Source code exported, including build scripts and licence notices.
entries.wording: Mahuyong i kodigo fuente, yan i script siha para u mafa'tinas i app yan i notisia siha put i lisensia.
Kreditu yan lisensia para i traduksion siha

entries.source: Pixel grid appears at 800% zoom or above. Rulers show positions in image pixels.
entries.wording: I guadru para pixels mamostra gi zoom 800% pat mås. I regla siha ha na'annuk i lugåt gi pixels di i pinenta.

entries.source: Open an artwork page and tap Use image. Search in English or Japanese; artwork titles and site text remain in Japanese. Free use is subject to Irasutoya’s terms: commercial designs using 21 or more items require payment. Special collaborations may have different conditions. Source pages and credits are kept under File → About, licences & credits → Image credits.
entries.wording: Baba i påhinan i pinenta ya patcha «Usa i pinenta». Aligao gi Ingles pat Hapones; i titulu yan i tinige' gi site manma'eskribi gi Hapones. Sigi i kondision Irasutoya an un usa sin apåsi: yanggin para i kometsiu ya un usa 21 pat mås na pinenta, debi na un apåsi. Siña guaha otro na kondision para i kolaborasion espesiat. I påhinan i orihin yan i kreditu mapo'lu gi «Dokumentu → Put AN Paint, lisensia siha, yan håyi fuma'tinas → Kreditu para i pinenta siha».

entries.source: Open an artwork page and tap Use image beside its Large PNG download. Openclipart publishes artwork under CC0. The source page and licence are kept under File → About, licences & credits → Image credits.
entries.wording: Baba i påhinan i pinenta ya patcha «Usa i pinenta» gi fi'on «Large PNG». I pinenta siha gi Openclipart mapublika gi papa' CC0. I påhinan i orihin yan i lisensia mapo'lu gi «Dokumentu → Put AN Paint, lisensia siha, yan håyi fuma'tinas → Kreditu para i pinenta siha».

entries.source: See the source page for the contributor.
entries.wording: Atan i påhinan i orihin para un li'e' håyi na'dåñå' i pinenta.
